facts.fact: FEZIX in Fez has 3 Moroccan members (Corebach Backbone, HOSTOWEB, PIXI MEDIA), 2 of 3 peering at the route server, and 210 Gbps aggregate capacity, per Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker (PeeringDB data, January 2026).

note: Document covers only FEZIX in Fez; all members Moroccan, so no reach fact.
